messages.subject: Moderated Mediation Power Analysis
parts: I'm trying to determine the minimum sample size for a moderated mediation model (conditional indirect effects). It looks like a Monte Carlo power analysis will be the best option. I think this is possible within lavaan, but I can't seem to figure out the syntax. Any help? Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Moderated Mediation Power Analysis
parts: I think this is possible within lavaan

lavaan does not estimate latent interations, unless you use product indicators.  Read references on the help page for the semTools function ?indProd.

simsem can be used for Monte Carlo power analysis.  Here is an example using varying N to find that N with a minimum power to reject a model.

https://github.com/simsem/simsem/wiki/Example-21:-Power-of-Rejecting-Misspecified-Models-with-Varying-Sample-Size
